svg.aria-label: How I Build. Every push is tested. pytest runs in GitHub Actions on each push. Data quality is a gate, not a report. Bad data stops the pipeline before it reaches consumers. Infrastructure is code. Cloud resources are declared in Terraform, not clicked together. Anyone can run it. Docker Compose, LocalStack and mock adapters mean no cloud bill or API key to evaluate the work. Honest data. Where data is synthetic, the README says so.
